semantic_diagnostic.reason: Run only after the frozen cheap lexical candidate missed held-out gates.

translation_diagnostic.reason: Direct Turkish visual retrieval lost only 6.67 pp to the English oracle, while translating Turkish queries away from Turkish ASR text collapsed speech R@5 to 12.5%. A full local MT dependency was not justified; path-specific semantic speech was the more direct diagnostic.

selected_language_strategy: Original Turkish query for routing; cheap path-specific normalization/lexical adaptation for diagnosis. No production promotion.

personal_acceptance_comparison.reason: Frozen Turkish development heldout routing and AUTO R@5 gates failed before production promotion.

negative_query_behavior.reason: Global no-match is outside this milestone and the personal acceptance rerun was not eligible.

remaining_blockers: Turkish route intent does not generalize across source groups: 76.67% heldout versus the 90% gate.
Cheap lexical adaptation reaches only 80% heldout AUTO R@5; visual adaptation can harm already-usable direct Turkish CLIP retrieval.
Multilingual semantic speech reaches 100% heldout Speech R@5 but adds about 480 MB cache, 254 MiB RSS and 10/14 ms median/p95 query latency, while total AUTO still depends on the failing router.
should_run_another_ml_milestone: Not immediately. Add independent Turkish source groups and freeze a new router-validation split before reconsidering the compact semantic speech branch; do not tune this heldout set.
